events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music and Art Fair, a pivotal moment in 1960s counterculture, began on this day in 1969 in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock 57th Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock. What was your favourite performance from the legendary festival?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who died in 1977 and would have been 91.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the King, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91. His music still moves millions. What's your top Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: We remember the influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot and killed in Las Vegas in 1996 and would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 today. His impact on hip-hop and music culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the death of the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970 and would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 today. His revolutionary guitar playing continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album "Abbey Road" in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us the masterpiece that is 'Abbey Road'. Which track is your favourite from that legendary album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer and founder of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her voice with The Pretenders is truly unmistakable. What's your favourite song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to solo hits, he's still got it. What's your favourite Liam track?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album "Imagine" was released on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released the timeless album 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: Original iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped 25 years ago? It changed everything for music lovers. What was your first iPod model?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British secret agent and the enduring film franchise.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles legend and peace activist John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the incredible legacy of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy icon. What's your favourite sketch or character?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as "The White Album," on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. Which track stands out most for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991 and would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
